description.p: A small 2D dual-engine lander with a green CRT look. The left and right engines (gamepad triggers, or the keyboard) rotate and thrust the ship. Fly through a large cave and land gently on the pads.
Three zoom levels, seven ships, music and effects, a title screen and options. Runs on desktop Linux, in the browser and on handhelds.

First release: dual-engine flight, wrapping caves with landing pads, springless bounce physics, three zoom levels, seven ships, title screen and options, synthesised sound and music, a GLES2 renderer, and builds for the web and the R36S.
